text:
maria: Quick heads-up: int8 onboarding for orion-v2 is showing a spike in funcall parse failures when streaming with kv-cache enabled. rate up ~0.8% -> 3.1% on the canary yesterday.

sam: saw the alert, logs point to trailing partial suffixes like ",\n" or missing closing bracket when a chunk ends mid-token.

jon: can you paste a raw sample?

maria: sure — here's one raw payload we captured from the mirror (truncated):
```json
{"tool":"lookup","args":{"id":12345},"result": {"name":"Alice","email":"alice@example.com"}
```
maria: note missing closing } after result object; model stopped mid-token.

kevin: is this reproducible on non-quantized fp16?

maria: nope, fp16 is clean. int8 streaming + kv-cache seems to increase tokenization boundary truncation (likely batch/chunk boundary differences).

jon: sounds like quantization changed token emission timing and the streaming chunks now sometimes cut the JSON in half. quick mitigations: 
1) soft-sentinel generation constraint: append a stable marker like "\n<END_JSON>" to each funcall output.
2) server-side repair: detect trailing partial JSON and run a small repair heuristic before marking as parse-fail.

sam: for (1) do we have control over prompt templates per canary?

maria: yes, we can push a prompt tweak for canary-only. canary-batch already has per-model prompt overrides.

eval-bot: Canary run completed: parse-fail rate dropped from 3.1% -> 0.4% for the canary group with sentinel enabled. latency +2ms, token delta negligible.

maria: nice. Proposal: keep sentinel for int8 streaming canaries and implement parser-repair with a capped retry budget (max 1 repair attempt, do NOT re-invoke the model to avoid cost/latency). cc @kevin to draft the repair PR.

kevin: will open PR today. plan: detect incomplete JSON suffix, try simple bracket balancing then a JSON5-style trailing comma removal, then re-parse. If still invalid, surface sample to offline bucket and don't retry the model. PR will include unit tests and a small fuzz harness.

jon: also add telemetry tag "quant_stream_partial" on sampled failures for offline analysis and correlate with kv-cache/sequence-length.

maria: thanks — follow-up plan: roll sentinel to 10% prod for 24h after PR lands, monitor parse rate + user-visible errors. will post metrics in #eng-ml.

sam: 👍
